cases.title: Design QA of agents list page from a written screen description
cases.input:
Please do a design QA pass. I can't attach images in this tool, so here's a precise description of the two screenshots plus the design requirements.

Product: Agent Archive, dark documentation-style UI (Tailwind tokens: canvas #0b0d12 background, panel #11141b, line #1f2430 borders, primary text #e6e8ee, secondary #a3a9b7, muted #6b7280, accent sky-400 #38bdf8, success emerald, warning amber). Font: Inter 14px body.

Design requirements:
- 8px spacing grid; card padding 20px; grid gap 16px.
- Body text contrast >= 4.5:1, small labels >= 4.5:1, interactive targets >= 44x44px on touch.
- Filter chips must show selected state with more than color alone.
- Max 2 lines for card summaries on desktop, no truncation mid-word.
- Korean (/ko) must fit without wrapping badges onto 3+ lines.

Breakpoints: 375px (mobile), 768px (md, grid becomes 2 columns), 1440px desktop with left sidebar (240px) and right table of contents (200px).

Screenshot 1 — /ko/agents at 1440px:
- Header: eyebrow "에이전트 라이브러리" in 12px uppercase sky-400, H1 "에이전트" 36px, description 14px secondary.
- Search input 48px tall, placeholder "이름, 역할, 작업, 태그, 도구로 검색..." in muted #6b7280 on panel #11141b.
- "설치 가능만 보기" checkbox is 16x16px with the label 14px.
- 6 filter groups (역할, 카테고리, 난이도, 자동화, 도구, 검증). Group titles 12px uppercase muted #6b7280 with 0.16em tracking. Chips are 24px tall (px-2.5 py-1, 12px text). Selected chip: border sky-400 at 40% opacity, bg sky-400 at 15%, text sky-200. Unselected: border #1f2430, bg #161a22, text secondary.
- The tool filter row has 49 chips and wraps to 7 lines.
- Result bar: "100개 중 100개 표시" left, "모두 지우기" right as sky-200 text link, 14px, no underline.
- Card grid 2 columns. Card top row: status badge "검증됨", difficulty badge "중급", "설치 가능" badge, "품질 4/5" badge, and a bookmark icon button 28x28px at the right. On some cards the four badges wrap to a second line and push the bookmark icon down so it is no longer top-aligned.
- Card summary text is clamped with min-height 48px but not line-clamped; two cards show a 3-line summary so cards in the same row have different heights up to the footer.

Screenshot 2 — /en/agents at 375px:
- Sidebar hidden; right TOC hidden. Search input full width.
- Filter groups stacked; the whole filter area is ~1100px tall before the first card appears.
- Chips 24px tall with 8px gap.
- Cards single column. "View agent →" link 14px at card bottom, tap area is text-only (~20px tall).
- The bookmark icon button is 28x28px.
- Horizontal scroll: none.

Please give QA findings with severity and concrete fix recommendations.
